notes.title: We heard that you really love the soundtracks!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945045/a7839f41069500b0d7f0d58643341a8c4c321d99.png[/img]
Hey there, friend!

We’ve been listening to your feedback and are excited to share some great news! We heard that you really love the soundtracks from our game. So, we’ve decided to make them available as a DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945045/a60139ea2af77ef2bb12f8ff90f06c4e8fd03ada.png[/img]

Now you can purchase your favorite tunes and support our game in the process! Your contribution helps us make it even better.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the music!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3007060/Conflux_Prologue_Soundtrack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945045/538bb350c76213262d3cc32b8e5ceb5b220cfb96.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes Update. Elizabeth's Voice. Tutorial localization issues.
notes.notes:
Patch Notes Update
Date: 21.05.2024

Highlights:

Elizabeth's Voice Change: We've updated Elizabeth's voice to enhance the gaming experience. Enjoy a fresh new sound while playing!
Localization Fixes: Various issues with tutorial localization have been addressed to ensure a smoother and more accurate experience for players across ukranian languages.
Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Conflux: Prologue is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Join us for an exciting live-stream event as we celebrate the release of Conflux: Prologue! Set in a fantasy world, Conflux: Prologue combines the engaging storytelling of a visual novel with the strategic depth of a collectible card game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945045/57c4a7658f7a708444bfb2e846bbee9a9f58c8cc.gif[/img]

In this special broadcast, we'll give you an exclusive first look at the  card battle mechanics and character hangout events that set this game apart. Discover the new world, meet the our characters.

Tune in and be part of our celebration. See you there!
